# Test: Automatic rollback from broken split-rootfs v2 back to split-rootfs v1
# Scenario: split(v1) -> broken-split(v2) -> automatic rollback to split(v1)
#
# Precondition: device is already running a good split-rootfs EVE v1
#   (for example after update_eve_image_split).
#
# This test sends an OTA to a split image where the ext-verity-roothash
# embedded in Core is corrupted. The Core boots on the other slot and
# connects to the controller, but extsloader fails dm-verity verification
# for the Extension. nodeagent keeps the slot in testing and then falls
# back to the previous split slot when the test window expires.
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION         - current good split-rootfs v1 tag (required)
#   EVE_VERSION_BROKEN  - broken split-rootfs v2 tag (preferred)
#   EVE_VERSION_2_BROKEN - broken split-rootfs v2 tag (legacy fallback)
#   EVE_VERSION_2       - broken split-rootfs v2 tag (fallback)
#   EVE_REGISTRY        - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)

{{$rollback_ver := "0.0.0"}}
{{$target_ver := "0.0.0"}}
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

{{$env_v1 := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION"}}
{{if $env_v1}}{{$rollback_ver = $env_v1}}{{end}}

{{$env_v2 := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION_2"}}
{{if $env_v2}}{{$target_ver = $env_v2}}{{end}}

{{$env_broken := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION_BROKEN"}}
{{if $env_broken}}{{$target_ver = $env_broken}}{{end}}

{{$env_v2_broken := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION_2_BROKEN"}}
{{if $env_v2_broken}}{{$target_ver = $env_v2_broken}}{{end}}

{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$env_hv := EdenGetEnv "EVE_HV"}}
{{if $env_hv}}{{$eve_hv = $env_hv}}{{end}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$rollback_short := printf "%s-%s-%s" $rollback_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$target_short := printf "%s-%s-%s" $target_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}

# ── Step 1: Verify current split state ───────────────────────
message 'Split->Broken-Split rollback: verifying current split state...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'split'

message 'Split->Broken-Split rollback: waiting for current Extension mount...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

# ── Step 2: Send OTA to broken split image ───────────────────
# Keep the window short so the automatic rollback happens quickly once
# extsloader cannot validate the Extension.
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=120

message 'Split->Broken-Split rollback: sending broken split update...'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update oci://docker.io/{{$eve_registry}}:{{$target_ver}}-{{$eve_hv}}-{{$eve_arch}} -m adam://
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for broken split boot (inprogress) ──────────
# The Core boots on the other slot, but the Extension never becomes ready.
message 'Split->Broken-Split rollback: waiting for broken split image to boot (inprogress)...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:inprogress InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $target_short }}'
stdout '{{ $target_short }}'

# ── Step 4: Wait for automatic rollback to split v1 ──────────
message 'Split->Broken-Split rollback: waiting for automatic rollback to split v1...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $rollback_short }}'
stdout '{{ $rollback_short }}'

# ── Step 5: Wait for SSH and verify split rollback state ─────
message 'Split->Broken-Split rollback: waiting for SSH after rollback...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

message 'Split->Broken-Split rollback: verifying rolled back split state...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'split'

eden eve ssh 'echo alive'
stdout 'alive'

# The failed slot Extension should be cleaned up; only the active split slot's
# Extension should remain after rollback.
eden eve ssh 'count=$(ls /persist/ext-img*.img 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "ext-img-count:$count"'
stdout 'ext-img-count:1'

eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

eden eve ssh 'ls /dev/mapper/exts-verity-* 2>/dev/null && echo verity-active || echo no-verity'
stdout 'verity-active'

# No GRUB HV menu should appear on any boot
exec bash check-no-grub-menu.sh

# "uni" must never reach runtime — check both the final value and that the
# safety fallback in onboot.sh was never triggered
eden eve ssh 'cat /hostfs/run/eve-hv-type 2>/dev/null | grep -qx uni && echo uni-leaked || echo hv-ok'
stdout 'hv-ok'
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -q "eve-hv-type resolved to .uni." && echo uni-safety-triggered || echo clean-resolve'
stdout 'clean-resolve'

message 'Split->Broken-Split rollback: SUCCESS'

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1

-- wait-extsloader.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 24 ]; do
    MOUNTED=$($EDEN eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo yes || echo no' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$MOUNTED" = "yes" ]; then
        echo "Extension mounted at /persist/exts"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "Waiting for Extension mount (attempt $((i+1))/24)..."
    sleep 10
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "Extension not mounted after 240s"
exit 1

-- check-no-grub-menu.sh --
#!/bin/bash
# Verify that NO boot in the current QEMU session showed the HV selection menu.
# The serial log uses logappend=on, so it may contain entries from previous runs.
# We only check from the LAST "swtpm is starting" line (marks current session).
EVE_LOG={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/default-eve.log

if [ ! -f "$EVE_LOG" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: EVE serial log not found at $EVE_LOG"
    exit 1
fi

# Extract current session: everything after the last "swtpm is starting"
CURRENT=$(tac "$EVE_LOG" | sed '/swtpm is starting/q' | tac)

if echo "$CURRENT" | grep -q "Boot/Install EVE"; then
    echo "FAIL: GRUB HV selection menu appeared during a boot!"
    echo "--- GRUB menu lines in current session ---"
    echo "$CURRENT" | grep -E "Boot/Install|Boot 0\." | head -10
    exit 1
fi

echo "OK: No GRUB HV selection menu on any boot in current session"
